card.name: Broken bytes inside non-Latin script characters
card.fires_on: Partial byte pieces in the middle of Lao or Chinese characters, or garbled symbols, mostly in text that mixes scripts. Also fires occasionally partway through odd words like adjourned or bronchodilator.
